description.value: The Bike Zone is a full-service bicycle shop in South Surrey stocking a wide range of road, gravel, mountain, commuter, and electric bikes from Specialized, Trek, and Cannondale. The shop offers repair services from flat tire fixes to complete overhauls, with tailored service packages designed specifically for mountain and e-mountain bikes. Touring cyclists will find a broad inventory of parts, accessories, clothing, and cycling gear under one roof.

address.value: 2393 King George Blvd, South Surrey, BC V4A 5A4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thebikezone.ca confirms an active bicycle retailer and service shop at 2393 King George Blvd in South Surrey, carrying Specialized, Trek, and Cannondale bikes including a large e-bike catalogue. The service subpage confirms repair work spanning flat tire fixes to full overhauls, with a dedicated Level 2 package for 'mid to high end mountain or e-mountain bike,' supporting e-bike service as true. The site explicitly states 'As of April 1st, appointments are required for service,' which is direct negative evidence for walk-in repairs and tempers the urgency value of the mechanicals criterion.
concerns: OSM name is 'The Bike Zone' (capitalized 'The') but the website consistently uses 'the Bike Zone' (lowercase 'the').
OSM record has no phone number; phone (604) 583-0969 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
OSM address lists 'Surrey'; website specifies 'South Surrey' with postal code V4A 5A4 — output uses the website's more complete value.
Appointments are required for all service/repair work as of April 1st, which significantly limits walk-in utility for touring cyclists with urgent mechanical needs.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, full-service bicycle shop with repair capabilities and a broad parts and accessories inventory; a clear resource for touring cyclists in the South Surrey area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Touring cyclists needing emergency repairs should call ahead; the shop now requires advance bookings for all service work.

E-bike service.detail: Service page describes a Level 2 Service package explicitly for 'mid to high end mountain or e-mountain bike,' including brake bleeds, tubeless sealant refresh, and pivot bearing checks. E-bikes are sold and serviced in-store
